title: Sir Elton: The Elton John Tribute in Las Vegas
includes: Show Tickets (Seating category selected at time of booking)
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible

cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Step into an intimate Vegas experience with Sir Elton—the city’s only all-Elton John tribute show performed live from the piano. Held in the Pegasus Showroom at Alexis Park Resort, this immersive performance features acclaimed musician Jeff Burkett channeling the magic of Elton through iconic hits like “Rocket Man,” “Tiny Dancer,” and “Your Song.” With vibrant costumes and storytelling, you’ll feel like you’re front row at an Elton concert—minus the arena crowds.
